elements.title: The Third Item in the Jeopardy Dataset
elements.details: Screenshot of a JSON formatted data item with keys and values: category: 'EVERYBODY TALKS ABOUT IT...', air_date: '2004-12-31', question: 'The city of Yuma in this state has a record average of 4,055 hours of sunshine each year', value: '$200', answer: 'Arizona', round: 'Jeopardy!', show_number: '4680'.
